payload.description_html:
An eel and a gadiform fish on a primarily rock bottom. The white objects are brachiopods attached to the rock surface. Small anemones and small corals are also seen adhering to the rock surface. 

   Image ID: expl6372, Voyage To Inner Space - Exploring the Seas With NOAA Collect
   Location: Pacific Ocean, Paramount Seamount
   Photo Date: 2011 July 14
Credit: NOAA Okeanos Explorer Program, Galapagos Rift Expedition 2011
